reached_sql:
WITH dj AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number,
           ss.ss_customer_sk,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN date_dim AS dd
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN store AS st
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    JOIN household_demographics AS hd
      ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE dd.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
      AND dd.d_year IN (2000, 2000+1, 2000+2)
      AND (hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
           OR hd.hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000')
      AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND hd.hd_dep_count > hd.hd_vehicle_count
      AND st.s_county = 'Williamson County'
    GROUP BY ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_customer_sk
)
SELECT c.c_last_name,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_salutation,
       c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
       dj.ss_ticket_number,
       dj.cnt
FROM dj
JOIN customer AS c
  ON dj.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE dj.cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY dj.cnt DESC, c.c_last_name ASC
